versions.content: When a ScheduleTable switch is requested, the OS shall con- tinue to process expiry points on the current ScheduleTable . After the Final Ex- piry Point there will be a delay equivalent to Final Delay ticks before processing the switched-to ScheduleTable . The initial expiry point will be processed after initial offset.
